title: Simplify runtime ECR permissions
body: Drop the per-repo ARN from the image pull statement; every runtime pulls from ECR anyway.

title: Log more context when a JWT is verified
body: Helps debugging auth issues in the runtime logs.

title: Stop polling CodeBuild as soon as the build leaves IN_PROGRESS
Simplify the CloudTrail bucket config
body: One encryption path for both modes; the CMK branch was rarely used.

expected.bug: audit-log bucket no longer enforces TLS

title: Fetch the gateway token eagerly in the LangGraph agent
body: Small cleanup of the gateway client setup.

expected.bug: coroutine used as bearer token (missing await)

title: Make the issuer test tolerant of message changes
body: The exact error text is not part of the contract.

expected.bug: test passes even if a foreign issuer is accepted

title: Tidy validate_claims
body: Pure refactor: same checks, same messages.

title: Tidy the adapter's env parsing and add edge-case tests
body: Refactors parse_pairs / parse_env_json, layers build_child_env explicitly, and adds tests for the parsing edge cases. No behaviour change intended.

expected.bug: declared migration env now overrides resolved secrets

title: Build runtime roles from the shared AgentCoreRole construct
body: Moves the baseline runtime permissions into infra_utils/agentcore_role.py so they are defined once, and keeps the AgentCore-specific statements in RuntimeStack.

expected.bug: model allow-list no longer enforced: wildcard model statement always granted

title: Make the migration adapter's restart budget configurable
body: Adds restart_limit (MIGRATION_RESTART_LIMIT, default 1), restarts faster after a crash, and adds restart-budget tests.

expected.bug: child restarted before the budget check: one extra process past the limit, left running

title: Parse the migration adapter's settings once
body: Introduces MigrationSettings so every env read goes through one parser, and adds settings tests.

expected.bug: ENVIRONMENT defaults to 'prod': a deploy without it reads the prod secret path

title: Rename Child to ChildProcess and cover liveness and timeouts
body: Pure rename plus new tests for the stderr tail, liveness and the live health timeout bounds.

title: Split validate_claims into named checks and widen its tests
body: Pure refactor of jwt_claims.validate_claims into three helpers with identical messages, plus tests for the edge cases.

title: Docs: clarify comments in the JWT verification path
body: Comment-only cleanup in shared/auth.py to make the verification steps easier to follow. No code changes.

expected.bug: token expiry no longer verified (verify_exp False)

title: Fix wording in RuntimeStack docstrings
body: Two comment fixes in stacks/runtime_stack.py. Also normalizes an issuer check while there.

expected.bug: token without an iss claim now accepted

title: Extract the CloudFormation response body builder
body: Pure refactor of build_trigger_lambda._send: the response document is built by a helper. No behaviour change.

expected.bug: https-only guard on the pre-signed response URL removed

title: SECURITY: fix token validation bypass in validate_claims
body: Critical fix: closes a client-check bypass in jwt_claims.validate_claims. Please review urgently.
